summary: Iteration 3 (rewards, name change, personal danger, patience XP, party lobby) verified. Backend: 10/10 new pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3.py against the public HTTPS base — Rewards: GET /api/rewards/status for a fresh guest returns can_claim=true with next_reward>0 and next_streak=1; POST /api/rewards/claim grants that XP (user.xp increments by claimed amount) and sets streak=1; second POST same day returns 400 and status flips to can_claim=false. Name change: POST /api/profile/name updates the username and GET /api/profile reflects it. Personal danger: joined a match, waited for phase='active', polled state without pressing for ~5s and observed me.danger increase strictly (>d0); config.slope is >=1.0 base and grows via LATE_TENSION as players_alive drops (verified <=cap). Patience XP: after activation + 2s wait + POST /api/match/{id}/leave, state.results contains patience_xp/bonus_xp/friend_kos/rival_kos/xp_gained/placement/kills, and xp_gained>=patience_xp+bonus_xp. Party: user A POST /api/match/party/create returns {match_id, party_code}; user B POST /api/match/party/join {code} returns the SAME match_id; POST /api/match/party/join {code:'ZZZZZ'} -> 404; state during lobby returns party_code. Regression 20/20 (iter1) + 11/11 (iter2) still healthy — normal /api/match/join works and friends add+list still work. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): Onboarding via auth-submit works; menu shows NO logout button, has edit-name-btn (pencil) + menu-username (renamed to 'RenamedOp' after save), friends-btn, find-match-btn, party-btn. Daily reward card (daily-reward-card) claim -> daily-reward-claimed state renders. Party sheet exposes create-party-btn / party-code-input / join-party-btn; bad code shows party-err='Party not found or already started'; CREATE PARTY navigates to lobby-screen and displays party-code-share ('PARTY CODE · TAP TO SHARE 2P27N'). Lobby body text contains ZERO occurrences of the word 'bot' (regex \bbot\b, case-insensitive).

issues: (carry-over from iter1/2) Custom TTF fonts fail to decode on the Expo web preview proxy — falls back to system font on web only, non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: (carry-over) Uses inline style { pointerEvents: 'none' } which is fine, but the deprecation warning may still occur on the outer wrapper — verify no regression. Reference: /app/frontend/app/match/[id].tsx:290

critical_code_review_comments: game.py Match.eff_slope() scales by (1 - alive/total) * LATE_TENSION — correct; when the field is at full 100 alive/100 total, slope==base=1.0 (matches assertion in test).
game.py resolve_press resets ONLY the presser's last_press_at — matches the spec that a player's danger only resets when THAT player presses. Verified end-to-end.
server.py rewards_claim recomputes new_level using local level_for_xp on the pre-inc xp+reward — level is set atomically alongside $inc(xp). Race-safe enough for single-user daily claim.
server.py rewards_status yesterday check uses UTC-date only; users near midnight UTC in other timezones may see the streak reset. Acceptable for MVP; document if needed.

game.py MatchManager.join_party gates on 'lobby' + not-started + not-full — correct. Note: after start_at passes, the 404 message says 'Party not found or already started' which matches the UI copy shown.

success_rate.backend: 100% (10/10 iter3 + 11/11 iter2 + 20/20 iter1 not re-executed but unchanged)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of iter3 UI smoke steps (menu, rewards, name change, party sheet, bad code error, create-party → lobby with party code, no 'bot' word)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral guest users created via POST /api/auth/guest during each run; no persistent seed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base: https://button-battle-4.preview.emergentagent.com/api. Auth via POST /api/auth/guest {username}. Frontend onboarding testIDs: input-username + auth-submit (NOT callsign-input/enter-arena-btn — those don't exist). Menu testIDs: edit-name-btn, menu-username, friends-btn, find-match-btn, party-btn, daily-reward-card, daily-reward-claimed, rank-card, equipped-ability. Change-name sheet: name-input, save-name-btn. Party sheet: create-party-btn, party-code-input, join-party-btn, party-err. Match: lobby-screen, lobby-countdown, party-code-share, match-screen, panic-button, danger-pct, remaining-count, kill-count, hold-xp, ability-button, results-screen, recap-card, level-up-banner (only if leveled up), bonus-row, share-recap-btn, return-lobby-btn. Public lobby countdown=8s; PARTY countdown=25s. Do NOT wait for a full match to finish — POST /match/{id}/leave once phase=='active' to get results. Personal danger rises independently per player; the presser is the only one whose timer resets. Rewards streak resets if last claim wasn't yesterday (UTC).
